title: fix(approvals): the no-approver note names its position by its label
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP3RHGWUG7UH3fNa4tBa9UC)_
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5okniknzVVR3KTSVr1

Fixes #36035

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 审批动态里「无人可审」那条系统说明不再显示岗位内部名：中文读者看到岗位的中文名（如「销售经理」），没有翻译时用岗位自己的显示名，都没有才退回内部名；英文审计原文不变。
- 接着上一轮「转交给管理员说明用岗位显示名」的修复，补上它留下的「无人可审」说明，属于控制台核心业务操作体验专题。
- 只改读取时的显示，库里存的审计原文和旧请求的说明都原样保留，转交规则不动；出问题可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

1. **The note stores its literals as a reference.** `no-approver-note.ts`: a new note stores `slots` (the slate's `type:value` literals, `noApproverSlots`) in the `__noApproverNote` snapshot entry instead of the pre-composed `who` string. `noApproverWho(slate, positionLabel?)` composes `type 'value'`, naming a position by the label `positionLabel` answers, else by its name. `noApproverSentence` / `noApproverNoteText` take an optional `positionLabel` and compose from `slots`; a note that stored `who` (written before this change) is rendered from that string exactly as before. `noApproverNoteOf` reads either shape.
2. **The read names the position the way #36030 does.** `ApprovalService.localizeRoutingNotes` builds the label map for the note's positions through the existing `notePositionLabels` (reader's pack `positions.NAME.label`, else the declared `label` from `positionLabelSource`, else nothing) and passes it to `noApproverNoteText`. No second resolver: the position-name extraction is `slatePositions`, factored out of `adminRescuePositions` in `admin-rescue-note.ts`, which now delegates to it.
3. **The stored English is unchanged.** The write site (`approval-service.ts`, one hunk) stores `slots`; the row's `comment` is still `noApproverNoteText(note)` with no render, which composes the same `position 'NAME'` English as before. The refusal remedy and the submitter's notice still compose from the slate with no labels (see Acceptance notes).
4. **Docs.** `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`, the no-approver paragraph: the note names the position by its label for a reader and by its name in the stored text.

`approval-service.ts` carries three small hunks (import, the write line, the read line); the note module could not carry the write and the read alone. `overlap-check` is clean against #36295, #36247, #36144 and #36135, which share that file.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins: admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts, new describe "[#36035] the no-approver note names its position by its label"</summary>

The suite's real `ApprovalService` on `ObjectQL` over in-memory SQLite, an organization with no administrator (so the request opens on the slate that names no one), the plugin catalog plus an app pack in a real in-memory `i18n` service, and a `positionLabelSource` declaring `sales_manager` as "Sales Manager".

- the snapshot stores `{ action_id, slots: ['position:sales_manager'] }`; the row stores the English with `position 'sales_manager'`; a no-locale read is served that English;
- zh-CN (pack label 销售经理) reads `...担任 position '销售经理' 的成员...` and no `sales_manager`;
- en and ja-JP (no pack key) read `position 'Sales Manager'`;
- a position no pack and no declaration knows (`treasury`) keeps its name;
- CONTROL: a note rewritten to the old stored shape (`who: "position 'sales_manager'"`) renders exactly as before in zh-CN, en and with no locale.

The pin went into the existing harness file as a sibling of the #35418 describe rather than a new file: it reuses that file's engine, organizations and `open` helper (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component with a shared harness goes into that file).
</details>

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `__noApproverNote` snapshot entry is internal to `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` (nothing in `packages/spec`, `ui/` or the package index reads it); new notes carry `slots`, older ones keep `who`, and the read accepts both.
- Same family, not in this PR, carried by #36308 (class a, user-visible): the decision door's refusal remedy and the submitter's `approval.comment` notice compose the no-approver sentence from the slate with no labels, so they still name the machine name (`...holds position 'legal'...`, pinned in `exclude-submitter.integration.test.ts`). The notice is rendered per recipient at delivery, so labelling it needs the recipient's locale, not the reader's.
- Observation, carried by #36308 (class a, user-visible): the `{{who}}` hole carries the approver type's English machine token in every pack, so a zh-CN reader now reads `担任 position '销售经理' 的成员`, where the administrators' note translates the type (`岗位「销售经理」`). Translating the type needs a per-type clause in all eleven catalogs; out of this card's scope.

## Verification

Read first: `no-approver-note.ts` (`noApproverWho`, `noApproverSentence`, `noApproverNoteOf` — the old/new shape split), the `localizeRoutingNotes` hunk in `approval-service.ts`, the write hunk at `slateSource = 'no_one'`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts -t 36035` — expect 5 passed.
